title: GEMglActiveTextureARB

messages.description: texture unit to make active, e.g. GL_TEXTURE0

arguments.description: texture unit to make active, e.g. GL_TEXTURE0

body: [GEMglActiveTextureARB] calls glActiveTextureARB() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. See glActiveTexture in the OpenGL reference.
